g.text: Expanded fields of selected parent descriptor
The four channel buffers can use unrelated DMA addresses.
Each channel provides N complex samples in B payload bytes.
One parent timestamp T applies to the first sample of every channel.

g.text: Each complete row spans B bytes = M × S.
IQ12: B = 3 × N bytes. IQ16: B = 4 × N bytes.
Host buffers contain sample payloads; T is descriptor metadata,
not a timestamp header inserted into the payload.

div.div:
Shared TX configuration — not repeated per parent
split_size = S bytes per channel
K = samples per TX segment (4096 in this configuration)
IQ12: S = 3K bytes · IQ16: S = 4K bytes

div.div:
Segment i — same sample interval on every channel
Source DMA address: addr_c + i × S
Scheduled first-sample tick: T + i × K
Whole segments: N = M × K and B = M × S

g.text: Dashed arrows associate address fields with the first payload byte; they do not show DMA sample traffic.
